candidates: Proofread all log messages and thrown error strings for spelling errors; they appear in production output and in developer tooling, making typos (e.g. 'Remozing' instead of 'Removing') harder to catch than code mistakes.

In every diagram detector plugin file (`*Detector.ts`), the `detector` const must carry an explicit `: DiagramDetector` type annotation (i.e., `const detector: DiagramDetector = …`), consistent with the pattern used across all other detector modules in this codebase.

In every new diagram definition file (`*Diagram.ts` or `*Diagram-v*.ts`), the exported `diagram` object must carry an explicit `: DiagramDefinition` type annotation (i.e., `export const diagram: DiagramDefinition = { … }`); omitting the annotation forfeits TypeScript's structural checking for required fields such as `parser`, `db`, `renderer`, and `styles`.
